{{Top|leg}}
'''Colony Seven''' was one of a number of colony cities established on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] to cater to the [[Cult of The One and The All]] and its [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-producing factories. Prior to the [[Battle of Ylesia]], the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aiaks Fwa]] was tasked by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to eliminate all of the [[t'landa Til]] priests residing there.
